name: EasyPXE-Nginx
description: EasyPXE Nginx provides HTTP delivery of iPXE menus, boot files, kernels, initramfs files and ISO images. It is the HTTP component of the EasyPXE network boot stack and must be installed together with EasyPXE-DNSMasq.

paths.name: Nginx Configuration Template
paths.description: Path to the EasyPXE Nginx configuration template.

paths.name: EasyPXE HTTP Files
paths.description: Directory containing boot.ipxe, menus, kernels and other HTTP boot files.

paths.name: ISO Library
paths.description: Unraid directory containing ISO images exposed through EasyPXE.

variables.name: Unraid IP
variables.description: Static LAN IP address of the Unraid server.

variables.name: HTTP Port
variables.description: Port used to serve EasyPXE menus, boot files and ISO images.
